id.description: The add-on's own manifest id. Must match the `id` in its manifest.json.

about.description: One or two plain sentences: what it adds and anything it needs (an account, an API key).

category.description: Catalogs are listed but only shown by app versions that support add-on catalogs.

manifest.description: HTTPS URL of the add-on's manifest.json, installable as-is. For add-ons that need setup first, the unconfigured manifest.

configure.description: The add-on's setup page, for add-ons that need an account or key. After setting up, people paste the link it gives them into Add-ons → Install from URL.

setupRequired.description: True when the add-on can't be installed until it's set up on its `configure` page (its manifest's behaviorHints.configurationRequired).

minAppVersion.description: Hide from app versions older than this.
